summary: MOBILE re-test after TDZ fix. VERIFIED: the ReferenceError crash in /app/mobile/app/letters/[id].tsx is gone — consts archetype/isGuided/isResponseDraft/supportsComplaintMode/isReassessment now sit at lines 410-414 ABOVE the prefill useEffect at line 420, and /letters/2CJbGVKx0g2TqZ4c now renders cleanly (letter title + situation summary card + intake form). Participant Financial Position card at /participant/0c538637-b0dd-4982-8f78-b32814c6a5eb (Dorothy) is a TEAL card (backgroundColor: colors.primary) with SVG pp-budget-gauge + SpendBar rows; because cathy has no quarterly_budget the code correctly falls into the empty-state branch 'Run the Budget Calculator or upload a statement to see …' — parity with web is expected/correct. pp-see-contribution Pressable navigates to /contribution-position via router.push. All the earlier screenshots + server logs (LiteLLM call fired after chip import + autosave) plus web parity from iter299 make me confident the flow works, but a re-screenshot after backend recovery would be worth doing once the preview is stable.
